status.en: 133 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Balochistan and Kabul.
status.nb: 133 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Belutsjistan og Kabul.

summary.en: Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security troops along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants in Balochistan. Pakistan has halted trade at two Iran border crossings and a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing as it advances a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. Iran's Balochistan border region is seeing growing unrest. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Taliban-styrker skjøt mot pakistanske sikkerhetstropp langs Kurram-grensen, og drepte en pakistansk offiser og flere militante i Balochistan. Pakistan har stanset handelen ved to grenseoverganger til Iran, og en tvist om Zangali-kontrollpost forstyrrer operasjonene ved Torkham-overgangen mens landet fremmer en forsvarspakt med Saudi-Arabia og Tyrkia. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød, og Taliban har åpnet en vei til Kina som møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Irans Balochistan-grenseområde opplever økende uro. 1 794 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
